digest.component_or_area: Generated artifact identification and drift gates
propositions: Two JSON derived files (index.json, criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers and have no comment syntax to carry them
Plans that cite derived files by line number cause implementers to edit the generated artifact instead of its source, failing drift gates and burning CI iterations
A top-level _generated_by string naming the regenerate command must be a fixed point emitted by the generator itself so it survives byte-identically through regeneration

The docs/README.md table must enumerate all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces with their sources, regenerate commands, and enforcing gates, and explicitly flag the three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces as NOT to be bannered
load_catalog() must skip underscore-prefixed keys so the _generated_by marker does not become a phantom reviewer in the prompt index

Two existing on-disk-equality tests (test_index_on_disk_matches_regenerated, test_user_write_does_not_change_committed_index) must be re-pointed to compare against build_index_document() instead of build_prompt_index() to account for the marker
